column1: Purpose: Track your daily paid ads numbers and what you're paying for a call booked, a call shown, and a completed qualified call.
1. Enter CPM, Outbound CTR, Outbound Clicks, Calls Booked, Calls Shown, Qualified Calls, and Amount Spent every day.
2. Calls Booked, Calls Shown, and Qualified Calls should match what your Sales Call Database shows for that day, don't count duplicates, reschedules, or follow ups.
3. Cost Per Call Booked, Cost Per Call Shown, and Cost Per Qualified Call fill in on their own from what you enter.
4. Each month has a summary row below it that averages or totals the month automatically, don't touch those rows.
5. This tab is Paid Ads only. Log your other business costs, labor, software, and so on, on the Expense tab.
